It is a favourite mop used for cleaning by the commercial industry because suitable for dry or damp conditions. Microfiber mop is a superior option for removing dirt, dust, and grime from wood floors or picking up larger debris such as hair, oil, dust bunnies, and dirt on any surface. Mr.Diy comes with a convenient and friendly-user microfiber mop to fulfill your needs by providing an excellent alternative for traditional mops by keeping your floors clean and spotless SCRATCH-FREE Microfiber mop will not leave marks or scratch other delicate surfaces such as tiles, wooden floors, laminate, bamboo, hardwood, and marble GOOD IN CLEANING Microfiber mops are really good for cleaning due to their high absorption, not only that it is streak-free and easily attract oil, dirt, dust, pet hair, grime, and dried-on, or sticky messes better than a traditional cotton mop. s_description_diy: WHAT IS (MR.DIY) MICROFIBER STRIP CLOTH MOP ? A microfiber strip cloth mop is designed to efficiently clean various flooring surfaces. It is really great and so easy to clean your floors quickly and effectively rather than a traditional cotton mop. It is a favourite mop used for cleaning by the commercial industry because suitable for dry or damp conditions. Microfiber mop is a superior option for removing dirt, dust, and grime from wood floors or picking up larger debris such as hair, oil, dust bunnies, and dirt on any surface. Mr.Diy comes with a convenient and friendly-user microfiber mop to fulfill your needs by providing an excellent alternative for traditional mops by keeping your floors clean and spotless SCRATCH-FREE Microfiber mop will not leave marks or scratch other delicate surfaces such as tiles, wooden floors, laminate, bamboo, hardwood, and marble GOOD IN CLEANING Microfiber mops are really good for cleaning due to their high absorption, not only that it is streak-free and easily attract oil, dirt, dust, pet hair, grime, and dried-on, or sticky messes better than a traditional cotton mop. Microfiber mop is suitable to be used for wet or dry mopping during your cleaning STAINLESS STEEL HANDLE Come with a long adjustable and durable stainless steel handle easy for you to do the cleaning without having to bend over to do cleaning for mopping. This gives you a better and more comfortable experience during mopping CONVENIENT STORAGE Hanging feature on the end of the handle so convenient for you to store, and freely hang either in the bathroom, store room, wet kitchen, or laundry SPECIFICATIONS Size: L97.5cm X W13.5cm (Handle until mop) Availability of Colour: Green, Cyan Packaging Included: 1x (MR.DIY) Microfiber Strip Cloth Mop (Handle is included)

FUMAKILLA Vape Aerosol is an insecticide aerosol spray designed to effectively kill and repel a variety of insects, including mosquitoes, house flies, moth flies, fruit flies, and winged termites. FEATURES Effective Insect Control: Targets and kills mosquitoes, house flies, moth flies, fruit flies, and winged termites effectively. Reduced Oiliness: Formulated to be 70% less oily compared to Fumakilla Aerosol-T, reducing residue and mess after application. Double Nozzle Cap: Equipped with a powerful double nozzle cap for efficient and broad spray coverage. Convenient Use: Easy to use with instructions for optimal effectiveness against different insects. USAGE INSTRUCTION 1. For Mosquito Control: • Close all doors and windows. • Spray FUMAKILLA Vape upwards throughout the room for about 3-4 seconds for a medium-sized room (around 60 cubic meters). • Leave the room and keep it closed for at least 10 minutes before reentry. • Ensure proper ventilation upon returning to the room. 2. For Other Insects (House Fly, Moth Fly, Fruit Fly, Winged Termite) • Spray directly on the insects from a distance of about 50 cm. SAFETY PRECAUTIONS • Avoid direct contact with skin and eyes. • Do not inhale spray mist. • Keep away from heat and open flames. • Do not spray towards humans, food, or kitchen utensils. • Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. SPECIFICATIONS Volume: 600ml Type: Aerosol spray Purpose: Kills mosquitoes, house flies, moth flies, fruit flies, and winged termites effectively Formula: 70% less oily compared to Fumakilla Aerosol-T Cautions: Avoid direct contact with skin and eyes, do not inhale spray mist, keep away from heat or flames, and do not spray towards people, food, or kitchen utensils. If your kids want to try out a creative way to expand their idea of drawings and art, this sponge can be cut off as the shape or design they needed then use watercolor as part of it. The sponge is also multi-purpose and can be used for a variety of cleaning jobs, like hard water stains in the bathroom, cleaning your shoes, sink and bathroom, and soap scum in the shower indeed result cleaning will leave clean and shiny surfaces MULTI-PURPOSE The sponge can be multi-purpose as your cleaning tool. This is not limited to cleaning your utensils and cutlery, but it also really works to clean and remove stubborn mold or stains on your bathroom walls, floor, vase, sink, wall, shoes, drawings, and colour marks on your wall EXCELLENT CLEANING Excellent results of cleaning ensure that all tough-to-clean dishes such as a grill, pots and pans, cookie sheets, and more will come out clean, spotless, and scratch-free SAVE TIME You do not have to spend so much time to do cleaning or scrubbing the stubborn stains on your utensils and cutlery EASY TO USE You just moisten the cleaning sponge with water, squeeze it and wipe the sponge, and there you go it is ready to be used for your cleaning jobs AS TOOL FOR ART Sponges also can be a part of our art tools too. If your kids want to try out a creative way to expand their idea of drawings and art, this sponge can be cut off as the shape or design they needed then use watercolor as part of it. Once it is done, you'll get the result of the design SPECIFICATIONS Size: L11cm X W7cm X H3cm Colour: White Packaging Included: 1x LINGYI Multi-Purpose Cleaning Sponge (1pc)
